claims.claim_text: Date of Incident: April 28, 2021
Time of Incident: Approximately 0430 hours
Location: Long Beach, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer C. Morrow
Badge Number: 9456
Officer(s): Officer C. Morrow, Multiple units
On April 28, 2021, at approximately 0430 hours, officers initiated a pursuit of a stolen vehicle being driven by the subject at speeds exceeding 90 miles per hour on the wrong side of the road.
The pursuit lasted approximately seven minutes, during which multiple patrol units were involved.
A PIT maneuver was executed in the southbound lanes, causing the stolen vehicle to collide with multiple parked cars.
Three of the four tires fell off the rims as a result of the collision.
The vehicle came to a stop and three patrol units positioned themselves approximately 15 feet away.
The subject remained seated in the driver's seat for less than 15 seconds.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject remaining in the driver's seat after the vehicle stops, contradicting the claim that he exited the vehicle in less than 15 seconds.

claims.claim_text: He then exited the vehicle, yelled profanities, and made threatening gestures toward officers with both hands moving to his right hip area.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject 'yelled profanities, and made threatening gestures toward officers with both hands moving to his right hip area.' The video shows the subject exiting the vehicle and standing, but there is no clear visual evidence of him yelling profanities or making threatening gestures with his hands moving to his right hip area. The subject is seen standing with his hands down, and the audio may contain yelling, but the visual evidence does not clearly show the described gestures.

claims.claim_text: Officers perceived a threat and one officer fired six rounds from his duty weapon.
Another officer deployed a TASER.
The subject fell to the ground.
claims.evidence_observations: At 02:58, the subject is seen exiting the vehicle and standing, and by 03:03, he is on the ground. The claim states 'The subject fell to the ground,' which is consistent with the video showing the subject being subdued and falling to the ground.

claims.claim_text: Officers broadcast shots fired and TASER deployment over the radio.
Paramedics were requested.
The subject was later determined to be unarmed.
Scene secured for investigation.
Body-worn camera footage
claims.evidence_observations: The entire clip is body-worn camera footage, supporting the claim that body-worn camera footage was used.
